title: AONIC 50 GEN 2 Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones
description: The Shure AONIC 50 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Headphones, Gen 2, are premium over-ear headphones designed for audiophiles and music lovers. They feature high-fidelity audio powered by precision-tuned 50 mm drivers and advanced Hybrid Active Noise Cancelling (ANC) technology to block out distractions. With the addition of Spatialized Audio, these headphones replicate the experience of listening through high-end speakers. They offer up to 45 hours of battery life, customizable EQ via the ShurePlus PLAY app, and an adjustable Environment Mode. The modern all-black design focuses on long-wearing comfort and durability, while Bluetooth 5 connectivity ensures a stable wireless range of up to 320 feet.

title: Sony WH-1000XM4C Gen2 Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones with Accessories
description: The Sony WH-1000XM4C Gen2 Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones combine advanced active noise cancelling technology with 40mm dynamic drivers for high-fidelity audio. Featuring the HD Noise Cancelling Processor QN1, these over-ear headphones utilize Dual Noise Sensor technology to adapt to the wearer's environment. They offer smart listening controls like Speak-to-Chat, Wearing Detection, and Adaptive Sound Control. With a battery life of up to 27 hours (NC on) and a quick-charge feature providing 5 hours of playback from 10 minutes of charging, they are ideal for travel and work. This bundle includes a carrying case, a headphone cable, and a Nautica Urban CB500 Premium Braided USB-C to USB-C cable.

title: Sony WH-1000XM6 Wireless Noise Canceling Headphones
description: Experience unparalleled sound quality and industry-leading noise cancellation with the Sony WH-1000XM6 headphones. Co-created with mastering audio engineers, these premium headphones deliver studio-quality audio, ensuring every note is heard as the artist intended. Advanced processors and an adaptive microphone system provide real-time, immersive noise cancellation, while the HD Noise Cancelling Processor QN3 optimizes performance with its 7x faster speed and 12 microphones. Enjoy crystal-clear calls, high-resolution audio, and a comfortable, tailored fit with a design crafted for durability and style. With up to 30 hours of battery life and intuitive controls, these headphones are perfect for any listening experience, anywhere.

title: Studio³ Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones
description: The Beats Studio 3 Wireless Headphones in Black are high-performance, over-ear headphones designed for a premium listening experience. They feature Pure Adaptive Noise Cancelling (pANC) to actively block external noise and real-time audio calibration for optimized sound. Powered by Apple's W1 chip, they offer seamless connectivity with both iOS and Android devices. The headphones provide up to 22 hours of wireless battery life and include Fast Fuel technology, where a 10-minute charge provides 3 hours of playback. Integrated multifunction on-ear controls allow users to take calls, manage music, and activate Siri.

title: Bose QuietComfort Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones
description: These Bose QuietComfort wireless over-ear headphones feature legendary noise cancellation technology and passive features to create a serene listening environment. Designed for premium comfort with plush earcup cushions and a padded headband, they offer two listening modes: Quiet for full immersion and Aware for surroundings awareness. Users can customize their sound with high-fidelity audio and adjustable EQ settings for bass, mid-range, and treble. With up to 24 hours of battery life on a single charge and a quick-charge feature providing 2.5 hours of play from 15 minutes of charging, they are ideal for long listening sessions. This bundle includes an Energizer Ultimate Portable Wireless Charge power bank.
